propositions: _hash_basis silently substitutes the working tree when the configured gate ref cannot be resolved, causing the claim gate to certify stale attestations that should be blocked

The claim gate's freshness re-check in compute_validity receives a degraded basis (working tree instead of attested gate ref) with no signal that degradation occurred, violating the documented fail-closed posture

When a signed attestation's dependency drifted on the gate ref but the working tree still matches the signed content, an unresolvable gate ref incorrectly returns ok=True/certified instead of ok=False/stale-code

The broad except Exception in _hash_basis catches not only missing refs but also snapshot materialization failures (_cache.acquire, _ensure_blobs_present), collapsing multiple failure modes into a single invisible WARNING log line
An attested gate configured to verify against ATTESTED source must refuse to certify when the gate ref basis cannot be obtained, instead of falling back to the working tree without notification
